summary: CRESUD filed a Form 6-K attaching a payment notice for Series XLVII Fixed Rate Notes due 2028. The filing announces the upcoming payment of the third interest installment on May 15, 2026, covering the period from November 15, 2025, to May 15, 2026. The outstanding principal is USD 64,417,023 with a 7.00% annual nominal interest rate, and the interest amount being paid is USD 2,236,064.88. Payment will be made in USD to noteholders registered as of May 14, 2026, through Caja de Valores S.A. as payment agent. This is a routine debt service announcement, not a special situation. There are no structural changes, strategic actions, or corporate events triggering a special-situation classification.
